newsitem.title: USA: Felcor Suite will offer 3 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Felcor Suite will offer 3 mln shrs.

text.p: FelCor Suite Hotels Inc said Thursday it is publicly offering three million shares of its common stock, with proceeds to be used for acquiring interests in additional properties.

It said the shares were being offered pursuant to its previously announced $500 million shelf registration statement, covering a variety of debt and equity securities, that became effective on April 12, 1996.
FelCor said the funds raised in the new offering are slated for buying an approximate half interest in eight joint ventures, each owing or leasing an Embassy Suites hotel.
